inventedEvidence.evidence: 'A blown plug fuse is a clue' - the customer said the fuse was fine and only swapped it as a precaution; the reply also implies a blown fuse.

blockingLoop.evidence: Re-asks about the socket, then the plug and lead, then bang or burning smell, all already covered. The customer asks 'What should I do next?' twice and gets no engineer referral.

rationale: The assistant repeated checks the customer had already done, such as the socket, plug fuse and unplugging, and its first reply even asked about a spur. It never raised warranty or booking an engineer, even though the customer asked twice what to do next. The final message wrongly treats a blown plug fuse as a clue, which contradicts what the customer said. Only the mention of a possible mains filter in turn 2 was on target, and it was not followed up.
